tools.name: b2b_quant_mcp_server
tools.description: Configure the Master MCP Server operationMode ('list_catalog', 'invoke_tool', or 'export_mcp_config'), target B2B tool name, JSON tool arguments, optional category filter, and optional Apify API token.

operationMode.title: MCP Operation Mode
operationMode.description: Select 'list_catalog' for free instant JSON-RPC 2.0 tools/list discovery of all 30 B2B tools, 'invoke_tool' to dispatch/validate a specific B2B tool call, or 'export_mcp_config' to generate ready-to-paste Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, and x402 configs.

toolName.title: Target B2B Tool / Actor Slug
toolName.description: Slug or MCP tool name of any of the 30 underlying @b2b-quant-apis engines (e.g., 'us-sec-edgar-filings-insider-radar', 'global-sanctions-pep-interpol-watchlist-screener', 'brazil-b2b-cnpj-qsa-lead-enricher').

toolArguments.title: Tool Call JSON Arguments
toolArguments.description: Structured JSON arguments passed to the target B2B tool when operationMode is 'invoke_tool'.

categoryFilter.title: Catalog Category Filter
categoryFilter.description: Filter the 30 B2B tools by domain category in 'list_catalog' mode ('ALL', 'FINANCE_KYB', 'GOVCON_PROCUREMENT', 'SECOPS_CYBER', 'HEALTHCARE_BIOTECH', 'BRAZIL_B2B_TAX', or 'ESG_LOGISTICS_GEO').

apifyApiToken.title: Apify API Token (Optional for Live Dispatch)
apifyApiToken.description: Optional Apify API Token to execute a live synchronous REST call against the target @b2b-quant-apis Actor during 'invoke_tool'. If omitted, returns a deterministic validated MCP execution envelope.

maxTools.title: Maximum Tools Returned
maxTools.description: Maximum number of B2B tool definitions to return in 'list_catalog' mode (1 to 30).
